compiled_state.title: Harness config loader with fixed test epic id + missing-epic failure
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: A fixed test epic id is named in harness config and used identically for pre and post runs; harness fails if named epic missing

## Description
Create `plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-token-reduction.py` config loader parsing YAML/argparse with `test_epic_id`, `tokenizer`, `pre_head_sha`, `post_head_sha`, `output_path`. Also create `plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-config.example.yaml`. Loader resolves test_epic_id via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket exists` and exits non-zero with clear error when missing. No measurement logic yet.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Harness script executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-token-reduction.py
- [ ] Example config exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-config.example.yaml
- [ ] Missing epic causes non-zero exit
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] --check-config succeeds for valid epic
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-token-reduction.py | Create |
| plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-config.example.yaml | Create |
| tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
